name: Lenny's Steakhouse
notes: Menu transcribed item by item from Lenny's Steakhouse's official full-menu PDF (shared by its Larchmont, Armonk and Stamford locations); prices and descriptions as printed. Address from website. Phone from website. Hours from OpenStreetMap. Menu notes: steaks served with Lenny's signature steak sauce; larger portions and cajun spice available on request; gluten-free and whole wheat pasta available.
